title: Reflect across the x-axis
observableEvidence: Finds the coordinates of a point reflected across the x-axis.
prompt: Point B is at (3, -7). If point B is reflected across the x-axis, what are the coordinates of the reflected point?
solutionRepresentation: Reflecting across the x-axis keeps the x-coordinate the same and flips the sign of the y-coordinate: (3, 7).
solutionMethod: Keep the x-coordinate the same and negate the y-coordinate.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept the coordinate pair with or without a space after the comma.

hintSteps.prompt: A reflection across the x-axis changes only one of the two coordinates.
hintSteps.question: Which coordinate, x or y, changes when you reflect across the x-axis?

hintSteps.prompt: The x-coordinate stays the same in a reflection across the x-axis; only the sign of the y-coordinate flips.
hintSteps.question: What happens to -7 when its sign flips?

hintSteps.prompt: In a similar problem, reflecting the point (2, -5) across the x-axis keeps the x-coordinate 2 and flips -5 to 5, giving (2, 5).
hintSteps.question: Using that same reflection idea, what happens to point B's coordinates?

review.originalityStatement: Written for this repository from first principles.

accessibilityNotes: Present coordinates as plain signed-number text; do not depend on a plotted graph image or color.
